cases.leadMessage: how does the program work?
cases.draft: Great question, and I want to give you the full picture. First we look at your credit profile in detail, including every tradeline, the age of your accounts, your utilisation across cards, and any derogatory marks that might be holding you back. Then we map that against what lenders in the business funding space are looking for right now, which changes month to month. After that we build a plan that sequences applications so you don't stack inquiries. Then we look at entity structure, business credit, and personal guarantees. Finally we prepare you for the conversations with lenders so nothing surprises you. It's a lot, I know, but it's worth it. Does that make sense? What's your credit score range?
